title: Plan the survey
goal: Plan a mission that covers the field at 40 m, upload it, fly it in Auto, and land.

steps.text: On the Mission tab, plan lines back and forth across the field at 40 m, then upload the mission.
steps.hint: Start with a take-off, then put waypoints at the ends of lines about 20 m apart across the field.

steps.text: Arm, switch to Auto, and let it fly the mission and land.
steps.hint: Auto flies the mission from the start. End it with Return to launch so it comes back and lands.

fails.says: Failed. A waypoint is more than 20 m outside the field.
